statement: A watcher delivery applies ordered bounded Entity frames at the old view before advancing height, then commits their effects, pending payload identities and view as one j_observation WAL record. Outputs leave only after that record is durable; the cursor moves only after commit. No crash may keep effects or cleared read waits without their covering view. Separate legacy height inputs require their events durable first.
source: watch.ts header and R-WATCH-ORDER (the view never runs ahead of an event it has not been told); R-HTLC-CLOCK; Review A of 118; slice-1 crash-boundary reproduction and atomic delivery design 2026-10-03
